specs.英文简介: The Canon Sure Shot Mega Zoom 76 (Euro: Prima Zoom 76, Japan: Autoboy Zoom 76) is a compact 35mm film camera with autofocus, a short zoom lens and built-in flash; a model in Canon's very successful Sure Shot range.
